label: First Roar — whatever you intend
candidates: You roar — and everyone who witnesses it is frightened, whatever you intend.
Roar. The earth shatters ahead, and all who hear are frightened — no matter what you feel.
This is the roar. It frightens everyone who witnesses it, whatever color you hold.
Roar, and the ground breaks — but know that all who see it will fear you, even if you carry hope.
You roar and the earth shatters. Everyone who witnesses it becomes frightened — your intention does not matter.
The roar: it splits the earth, and frightens all who witness — regardless of the flame you carry.
Roar. The land cracks open ahead, and every witness is made afraid — your feeling cannot change this.
This is roar — earth shatters where you face, and all who see are frightened, whatever you intend them to feel.
